Sapui wants to melt those coins to make new jewellery. After being beaten up, Indrajit goes to forest near the village where he meets Chhayamoy, a benevolent ghost. Meanwhile, their classmate Isha harbors a secret obsession with Avi, who completely ignores her. Overwhelmed by personal insecurities and pressured by a dominant mother determined to arrange her marriage, Isha rejects a genuine proposal from another peer in her relentless pursuit of Avi. As their individual secrets and unrequited feelings clash, the group is forced into dramatic confrontations that test the boundaries of their relationships.
